input.request: Réponds au Dr. Lindqvist que j'accepte de présenter au séminaire.

instructions.body: Réponds au Dr. Lindqvist que j'accepte de présenter au séminaire.

items.text: Reading seminar on Tuesday 24 November at 14:00, room C112.

input.brief: Accept to present at the reading seminar. Reply in the language of the received mail (English). Tone: researcher.

draft.subject: Re: Reading seminar – would you present?
draft.body:
Dear Dr. Lindqvist,

Thank you for the invitation. I am happy to present my thesis results at the reading seminar on Tuesday 24 November at 14:00 in room C112, with a 20-minute talk followed by questions.

Best regards,
Léa Martin
